Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for offering to come on-site during our visit the week of June 23. We have a block on June 25 (afternoon) and June 26 (morning) that leadership cleared for product demos. Can you confirm availability for a 90-minute deep-dive on either of those windows?

High-level goals for the session:
- Security and data handling overview (CISO + IT)
- Live walkthrough of Redwood Dedicated and routing policies (product + engineering)
- Cost/throughput discussion (finance)

If you can send a brief agenda and any pre-read we should distribute to the group that would help.

Appreciate it — Jenny

Jenny — really appreciate the quick turnaround and the goals. June 25 (2:00–3:30pm PT) or June 26 (9:30–11:00am PT) both work on our side.

I attached a draft agenda (HarborCore-demo-agenda.pdf) and a short list of items for IT to have handy (network egress, firewall rules, sample payloads). If the CISO wants a focused security slot we can push a 20–30 minute segment earlier in the session.

Proposed plan:
- 15m — introductions & product context
- 30m — security/compliance walkthrough (SOC2, network controls)
- 30m — live Dedicated demo + routing/cost controls
- 15m — Q&A + next steps

If you confirm a time I’ll book travel and add Marissa for the capacity discussion. Attachment: HarborCore-demo-agenda.pdf

Vivek — quick update: our VP of Ops had to extend a family leave travel unexpectedly and wants to stay on-site through the 27th. That shifts a couple of calendar constraints we hadn’t anticipated.

We still absolutely want the demo, but the full 90-minute slot with our cross-functional team is harder to lock in now. Two options we’re considering on our side:
1) Keep a shorter 45-minute live exec-level demo during the original June 25 afternoon slot (leadership only), and then record a deeper technical session to be shared with IT/engineers asynchronously.
2) Move the full 90-minute walkthrough to Tue, July 1, when travel windows free up.

Which would you prefer? We’d like to avoid losing momentum but also want to make sure the engineering folks get the hands-on detail.

Also, IT will need a visitor pass for two Redwood folks — can you confirm names so we can generate passes?

— Jenny

Thanks for the heads up, Jenny — sorry to hear about the travel extension. We can support either path; my recommendation is to split: do the 45-minute leadership demo on June 25 (2:00–2:45pm PT) and then record a 60–75 minute deep technical walkthrough that we deliver asynchronously the next day with an optional live office-hours Q&A for engineers the week of June 30. That keeps momentum and ensures the technical teams get the detail without making anyone change travel plans.

Quick logistics:
- Onsite (June 25): Vivek Kulkarni, Marissa Cole — please issue visitor passes for both (I’ve attached a stub visitor-pass.pdf with our names for your badge office).
- Async deep-dive: we’ll record the Dedicated runtime demo and include a short primer doc for your infra team.
- Optional office hours: Tue, June 30 at 11:00am PT (60 min) — we can make this remote.

Attachments: visitor-pass.pdf (stub), HarborCore-demo-agenda.pdf (updated with split session notes).

If that sounds good I’ll send calendar invites and a recording plan.

Cheers,
Vivek
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
